## Workflow index

| Workflow | Purpose | Stages |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Feature delivery (feature-delivery) | Move a bounded product or engineering idea from discovery through implementation, verification, review, and release readiness. | product-discovery: Clarify the user problem and evidence before committing to a solution.<br>shape-up: Bound appetite, solution direction, rabbit holes, and explicit exclusions.<br>phased-delivery: Turn approved scope into independently reviewable phases, one PR per phase or ticket.<br>code-quality-gate: Check implementation quality, risks, and readiness using repository evidence.<br>pr-review: Perform an independent review before release work.<br>ship-it: Prepare rollout, monitoring, rollback, and post-release verification. |
| Bug fixing (bug-fixing) | Move a concrete defect from reproduction through diagnosis, regression coverage, review, and release. | bug-to-fix: Establish a reproducible failure and smallest defensible fix.<br>cover: Prevent recurrence with focused behavior-level coverage.<br>webapp-testing: Exercise user-visible flows when the defect crosses the browser boundary.<br>code-quality-gate: Confirm the fix is scoped, maintainable, and sufficiently verified.<br>pr-review: Check for regressions or unintended behavior before shipping. |
| Pull request review (pr-review) | Review, improve, and close feedback on a pull request with explicit evidence and communication. | pr-review: Find correctness, regression, maintainability, and risk issues independently.<br>pr-improve: Implement accepted findings and verify the changes.<br>phase-gate: Confirm review corrections and evidence are complete before closeout.<br>pr-review-reply: Reply to each thread with evidence or a clear disposition. |
| Codebase improvement and refactor (codebase-improvement) | Prioritize and execute bounded maintainability, migration, and structural improvements with behavior evidence. | crap-analysis: Use complexity and coverage signals to choose high-value targets.<br>simplify: Remove unnecessary complexity within a narrow behavior boundary.<br>retrofit: Handle migrations and compatibility changes incrementally.<br>cover: Protect behavior while structural changes land.<br>code-quality-gate: Confirm the improvement reduced risk without introducing regressions. |
| Security-sensitive change (security-sensitive-change) | Design, implement, test, and review changes involving sensitive data, privilege, or trust boundaries. | threat-model: Identify assets, trust boundaries, abuse cases, and mitigations before coding.<br>test-case-design: Turn threats and requirements into negative, boundary, and regression cases.<br>cover: Make critical protections executable and regression-resistant.<br>security-audit: Inspect the resulting implementation and configuration for exploitable gaps.<br>code-quality-gate: Check evidence, maintainability, and release readiness across the risk boundary.<br>pr-review: Provide independent final review of correctness and residual risk. |

| Skill | Canonical description | Display name | Short description | Default prompt |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bug-to-fix | Diagnose and fix reported bugs through triage, reproduction, root-cause analysis, minimal repair, and verification. Use for bug tickets, broken/failing/slow behavior, RCA requests, or turning a confirmed defect into a verified fix. | Bug To Fix | Diagnostic bug workflow from triage and reproduction through root cause, minimal fix, and verification. | Diagnose this bug and drive it to a verified fix. |
| code-quality-gate | Run a focused pre-PR quality gate when repository policy, user request, or change risk calls for repository checks and changed-code maintainability evidence; not for broad cleanup. | Code Quality Gate | Verify pre-PR code quality evidence | Use $code-quality-gate to assess the current diff before PR readiness. |
| cover | Author behavior-pinning tests for a diff, module, or bug reproduction, applied on opt-in. Use when adding regression coverage or strengthening tests. For finding untested areas use /cover-gaps; for a merge verdict use /pr-review. | Cover | Author behavior-pinning tests for a diff, module, or bug reproduction on opt-in. | Propose tests that pin this behavior. |
| crap-analysis | Run CRAP analysis via repo-configured commands — wizard setup, single-run orchestration, deterministic report review, and opt-in refactor. Use for /do-crap-analysis, /crap-config, or /crap-refactor. | CRAP Analysis | Configure and run CRAP analysis via repo commands — deterministic review and opt-in refactor. | Run CRAP analysis on my uncommitted changes. |
| handoff | Write a resumable handoff so a fresh agent or person can continue the work without context loss. Use proactively before a context reset or compaction, when pausing a long task, or when transferring work between sessions, agents, or people — in any workflow. | Handoff | Write a compact, resumable handoff for another session, agent, or person. | Write a resumable handoff for this work. |
| phase-context-workflow | Manage durable phase context for long coding-agent work. Use when planning, implementation, testing, review, and PR prep should be split into resumable phases with repo-tracked phase files, handoffs, context packets, and safe /clear or /compact boundaries. | Phase Context Workflow | Durable phase context for resumable long-running coding-agent work. | Set up durable phase context for this work. |
| phase-gate | Run a synchronous PR-review gate at a phased-build boundary. Use when each phase PR needs an isolated subagent review, posted findings, and either team handoff or solo fix-and-merge routing. | Phase Gate | Synchronous PR-review gate at a phased-build boundary with isolated review and routing. | Run a phase gate review for this phase PR. |
| phased-delivery | Plan and deliver a requirement in reviewable phases, one PR per phase. Use with a raw request, an existing plan, or approved tickets; when tickets are supplied, map one ticket to one phase and one PR. | Phased Delivery | Deliver requirements or tickets as one PR per phase. | Use $phased-delivery to plan and deliver this requirement as reviewable PRs. |
| pr-improve | Iteratively fix an agreed PR review ledger within a frozen scope and verify each round. Use to improve a PR after findings exist; not for one-time review or broad cleanup. | PR Improve | Improve a PR in bounded verified rounds. | Use $pr-improve to address accepted PR findings within scope. |
| pr-review | Review a PR, branch, or local diff with a tiered, multi-agent code-review process (light/standard/deep). Use before merge or when auditing changed code for bugs, security, performance, tests, maintainability, and standards compliance. | PR Review | Tiered code review for PRs, branches, or local diffs with evidence-backed findings. | Review this PR, branch, or local diff. |
| pr-review-reply | Handle the PR-review round-trip: read reviewer threads, triage each one, re-review only touched code, and draft per-thread replies. Use to address PR comments, answer review feedback, or close a /pr-review loop. | PR Review Reply | Triage PR review threads, re-review touched code, and draft per-thread replies. | Handle these PR review comments. |
| product-discovery | Frame a product opportunity with evidence, assumptions, risks, experiments, and success thresholds before shape-up. Use when deciding what to build, not when a brief is already approved. | Product Discovery | Assess evidence before shaping a product idea. | Use $product-discovery to assess this opportunity before shaping. |
| retrofit | Apply one defined change across every required site, such as a library swap, API rename, framework upgrade, or pattern replacement. Use for codebase-wide mechanical changes. Not for deciding the change or database migrations. | Retrofit | Apply one defined mechanical change across every required site in a codebase. | Retrofit this change across the codebase. |
